title: ADRs
intro: Architecture Decision Records: every decision, from the problem raised to the decision in force. Everyone can read them and raise a new one.
createIntro: Describe the problem or question. You become the Driver; the rest can be written, and the other roles named, later.
createDaciHint: You are the Driver. Name the others now, or later from the ADR page.
nameDefaultHint: Optional: the first line of the problem is used when this is empty.
notFound: This ADR does not exist (or was deleted).
deleteBody: {{key}} "{{name}}" will be deleted. Its number is never reused.

filter.mine: Only ADRs I take part in
filter.searchPlaceholder: Words from the name or the text
filter.searchHint: Type at least 2 characters, including a letter or a digit, to search.
filter.rangeInverted: The start date is after the end date.
filter.relevance: Sorted by relevance. Click a column heading to sort by it instead.

status.closed: This ADR is closed: it is read-only.
status.noMoves: No status change is available to you.
status.waitingAcceptance: Waiting for {{key}}'s Approver to accept this ADR as its successor; it cannot be activated before.

CANCELLED.title: Cancel this ADR?
CANCELLED.body: A cancelled ADR is closed for good: nobody can edit it or move it again.

WITHDRAWN.title: Withdraw this ADR?
WITHDRAWN.body: A withdrawn ADR is closed for good: nobody can edit it or move it again.

WITHDRAW_ACTIVE.title: Withdraw this decision?
WITHDRAW_ACTIVE.body: The decision stops being in force and the ADR is closed for good: nobody can edit it or move it again. Open issues can still be resolved.

SEND_BACK.title: Send this ADR back to draft?
SEND_BACK.body: It goes back to drafting; its content, people and tags are kept, and the Approver will have to review it again once you send it back to review.

confirm.reasonHint: Shown in the history. The people on the ADR are told about the move, not the reason.
confirm.reasonRefused: The reason was refused: it must not contain control characters or hidden direction characters, or be longer than 1000 characters.

fieldHint.context: Why it matters: constraints, assumptions, who it concerns. Needed to enter review.
fieldHint.decision: What was decided. Needed to enter review.
fieldHint.alternatives: The options that were weighed. Optional.
fieldHint.consequences: What follows from the decision, good and bad. Needed to enter review.

daci.driverHint: Drives the ADR. Exactly one; hand it over, never leave it empty.
daci.approverHint: Decides: activates or withdraws. At most one.
daci.approverLockedHint: Once the ADR has been in review, only the Approver or an administrator can change this.
daci.contributorHint: Edit the content and take part in the discussion.
daci.informedHint: Only read and are kept informed.

details.expiryHint: The last day the decision is in force. Empty clears it.

event.EXPIRED: Expired: the expiry date {{expiresOn}} has passed

validation.reasonCharacters: The reason must not contain control characters or hidden direction characters

error.createInvalid: Check the fields: the problem is required, the lengths are limited and the people you name must be active users.
error.saveInvalid: Check the fields: the name and the problem are required, the lengths are limited and the expiry date must not be in the past.
error.transitionInvalid: Not ready for that move: entering review or activation needs a context, a decision, consequences and an Approver, an expiry date that is not in the past, and - when this ADR replaces another one - that ADR being active.
error.participantsInvalid: Check the participants: exactly one Driver, at most one Approver, each person once, and only active users can be added.
error.revisionConflict: Someone else changed this ADR after you opened it. Reload it to see the latest version; unsaved edits in the open form are discarded.
error.frozen: This ADR is frozen: its content can no longer be changed in its current status. Reload to see its latest state.
error.illegalTransition: This ADR cannot move there from its current status. Reload to see what is possible now.
error.forbidden: Your role on this ADR does not allow this.
error.participantsForbidden: Nobody but an administrator can make themselves the Approver, and once the ADR has been in review only its Approver or an administrator can change who the Approver is.
error.nameTaken: An ADR with this name already exists.
error.tagsInvalid: Check the tags: use only tags from the registry (remove a retired one), each once, at most 20.
error.supersedesInvalid: Check the link: pick another ADR that is active or still being drafted.
error.supersedesConflict: That link is not possible: it would close a loop of successors, or that ADR already has a successor on its way.
error.detachGone: This ADR has no pending successor any more. Reload to see its latest state.
error.successorNotAccepted: This ADR cannot be activated yet: the Approver of the decision it replaces has to accept it first. Ask them to open that ADR and accept it.
error.acceptGone: That successor is not pending any more. Reload to see this ADR's latest state.
error.acceptConflict: This ADR is not in force yet, so its successor cannot be accepted. Reload to see its latest state.

discussion.title: Comments and questions
discussion.closedNote: Comments and questions are taken until the ADR is active. What was said stays readable.

issues.title: Issues and escalations
issues.notYetNote: Issues and escalations can be raised once the ADR is active. Until then, use the discussion.
issues.closedNote: This ADR is no longer active, so no new issues can be raised. What was raised stays readable.

kindHint.QUESTION: Ask for something to be clarified; the Driver, the Approver or you can mark it answered.
kindHint.ISSUE: Report that the decision does not work as intended; the Driver or the Approver resolves it.
kindHint.ESCALATION: Raise what needs the Approver's attention now; the Driver or the Approver resolves it.

discussion.deleteBody: Its text is removed for good; a placeholder stays in the thread.

error.closed: The ADR's status no longer takes this. Reload to see its latest state.
error.invalid: Check the text: it must not be empty and at most 10,000 characters (a resolution note at most 2,000).
error.gone: This entry or its ADR no longer exists.

tags.label: Tags
tags.hint: Only tags from the registry can be used; administrators curate it.
tags.retiredHint: A retired tag is no longer in the registry. It is dropped when you save.
tags.empty: The registry has no tags yet.
tags.loadFailed: Could not load the tag registry

successor.hint: Takes effect when this ADR becomes active: the ADR it replaces is then superseded.
successor.predecessorOver: {{key}} is no longer in force ({{status}}), so there is nothing left to replace. Remove the link before this ADR is activated.
successor.pickerPlaceholder: Search ADRs by key or name…
successor.waiting: Waiting for the Approver of {{key}} to accept it; this ADR cannot be activated until then.
successor.notYet: {{key}} is not in force yet; its Approver accepts the link once it is.

proposed.title: A successor is proposed
proposed.body: is proposed to replace this ADR. Once this decision is in force, its Approver has to accept the link before the successor can take effect.
proposed.acceptMessage: {{key}} may then replace this decision: when it becomes active, this ADR is superseded. You can still detach it before that.

superseded.title: This ADR is superseded
superseded.body: The decision in this ADR was replaced by

pending.title: A successor is on its way
pending.body: is set to replace this ADR; once it becomes active, this ADR is superseded.
pending.detachMessage: {{key}} stops being set to replace this ADR and this ADR stays as it is. The link is its Driver's to set again; nothing else in that draft changes.

export.tooBroad: Cannot export: an export holds at most 500 ADRs, or a filter was refused. Narrow the filters and try again.
export.busy: Other exports are running right now. Try again in a moment.
